description: Designing Lookup vs Master-Detail vs Hierarchical vs External relationships: cascade delete, roll-up summaries, ownership, sharing implications, polymorphic lookups, junction objects, relationship depth limits. NOT for restricting which records a lookup can pick — use admin/lookup-filter-cross-object-patterns. NOT for a roll-up across a plain lookup — use data/roll-up-summary-alternatives.
inputs: Parent and child objects under design
name: lookup-and-relationship-design
official_sources: Winter '27 (264) re-check, 2026-10-20 — master-detail cascade, Owner, sharing-rule/queue restriction and inherited sharing (object_reference 264 L3305-L3309); external objects take only lookup, external lookup and indirect lookup (L3293-L3294); junction objects (L3341-L3343); `deleteConstraint` values (api_meta 264 L45591-L45597); `relationshipOrder` (L45809-L45818); `summaryForeignKey` (L45869-L45870); user hierarchy field as approver (L25502-L25505); relationship query limits 55 / 20 / 40 / five levels (salesforce_app_limits_cheatsheet 264 L687-L719); polymorphic `What.Type` and `TYPEOF` (salesforce_apex_developer_guide 264 L9939-L9948). The SOAP API status-code guide (`CHILD_SHARE_FAILS_PARENT`) is not in the 264 corpus.
